note: Cached canonical HTML contract essentials from learn_post_authoring. Reuse across daily runs.

template_newsletter.description: The canonical 'Template Newsletter' draft to replicate. DARK theme. Structure: 16:9 cover imageBlock with 30px rounded corners at top -> intro paragraph -> story sections (h2 heading + optional inline 16:9 image + body paragraphs) -> full-width 'Share' button linking {{rp_referral_hub_url}}. All content wrapped in node-section divs with data-background-color=#222222, data-color=#FFFFFF, padding ~18-20.

theme_tokens_to_apply.note: The Template Newsletter carries its OWN per-post theme (source: post). The publication default is LIGHT (white bg, dark text), so headings/text would be invisible on dark sections unless you fork a per-post dark theme. Apply these via save_post_theme on each new post to match the template exactly.

ad_nodes.learnings: IMPORTANT ad-placement rules discovered 2026-10-28: (1) Embed ALREADY-ACCEPTED opportunities (list_ad_opportunities status=accepted, UUID ids), NOT fresh list_ad_offers numeric ids. Claiming new offers via save_post hits an acceptance cap ('can not accept any more opportunities') and the numeric offer ids are ephemeral/regenerate per call. (2) A post allows at most ONE 'primary' (with-logo) ad slot; 3x primary is rejected ('No primary ad slot available'). Use 1 primary + the rest 'secondary'. (3) 3 accepted opportunities embed fine in one post (1 primary + 2 secondary verified).

recipients.note: Publication is FREE-only (list_tiers returns 0 active tiers). Send free on web + email.
